example.rule: second.previous = H('rapp/1:particle', first), over the complete entry with its sig; each notice is a declared entry signed over canonical(entry \ {sig})

state_at.rule: the notice in effect at utc is the last chain entry whose since_utc <= utc (bytewise); its state and superseded_by are those in effect at utc. A null state is no declared lifecycle, never deprecation; a null superseded_by names no successor at utc, and a scheduled notice names none before its since_utc

signature_boundary: sig values are placeholders; accept/refuse covers structure, uniqueness, and chains. Verify §10/§13.4 signatures with real keys in your own tests.
